findings.text: The dossier exposes families of page and folio state markers for virtualization remap, reservation, swap backing, filesystem private use, second private and second owner indicators, writeback, disk mapping, reclaim, readahead, drop behind and RCU deferred release, each offering only the query and update operations appropriate to its lifetime.

Each marker carries a compound scope contract with some forbidding compound use, some forbidding tail access, some allowing any page, and folio scoped markers applying only at the head page, so callers must select head versus member access accordingly.

Writeback provides only atomic check operations because unconditional changes would bypass accounting, while private filesystem markers imply that release handling will be invoked and therefore must not be set casually.

Deferred RCU release moves from unset to set only while holding a reference or during split propagation, remains set across a grace interval after the reference count reaches zero, and clears only at allocator free; a lockless lookup that observes the marker and then revalidates the slot with an ordering barrier may safely use the memory until unlock, except for nolock or non allocator frees such as hugetlb.

High memory detection is based on the zone index of a page or folio when that configuration is present and reports false otherwise; physical address classification converts through the page mapping, and partial mapping for local folio access is forced true under a debug configuration and otherwise follows high memory status.

Flag word access for a folio member validates compound metadata and head status before returning the addressed word, swap cache membership requires both swap backing and the swap cache bit, and a bio vector physical address is derived from its page base plus its offset.

The generic ordering layer provides host to little endian and host to big endian translations in both directions for sixteen, thirty two and sixty four bit widths, including plain value, pointer based and in place update forms.

Network order aliases map to big endian conversions, small integer accumulation updates a stored little or big endian value from a host addend, and bulk helpers convert whole word arrays or copy between host and little or big endian representations element by element.

In place conversion for thirty two and sixty four bit little endian values swaps bytes on big endian builds and does nothing on little endian builds, so generic array loops inherit platform dependent behavior from those primitives.

Size rounding helpers align upward to first level cache width, symmetric multiprocessing cache width and the largest natural alignment, while a query reports the current line width and DMA safe alignment defaults to the widest integer requirement when no architecture override exists.

Placement annotations mark frequently read data, post init read only data, and symmetric multiprocessing conditional cacheline alignment for variables and types, with internode spacing defaulting to first level shift unless overridden.

Cacheline grouping uses zero length markers to open and close a region with optional aligned variants that pad the tail, and an optional padding type provides internode aligned empty space when that configuration is enabled.
Compile time checks fail the build when a structure member lies outside its declared cacheline group or when a group footprint exceeds a stated size limit.

Coherency invalidation parameters carry an address and length, operations provide writeback invalidate and completion callbacks, and an instance combines a reference count with list linkage and a pointer to its operations.

Instance allocation for a driver container requires the embedded instance to have identical type and to sit at offset zero of the container, returning a container pointer sized for the driver structure.
Default cache maintenance provides an empty data flush for folios and an empty instruction flush for a page range, with a single page instruction flush expressed as a one element range flush.

A cache descriptor records identity, kind, level, line size, set count, associativity, line partition, total size, shared CPU coverage, attribute flags, firmware token, sysfs control and private data, while per CPU state holds the descriptor list, slice sizing, level and leaf counts and population flags.

Cache kinds use zero for no cache, bit zero for instruction, bit one for data, combined low two for separate, and bit two for unified; attribute flags use bit zero for write through, bit one for write back, bit two for read allocate, bit three for write allocate, and bit four for identifier present, with one mask covering the write policy pair and another covering the allocate pair.

Firmware cache discovery returns a negative not found status by default, level lookup scans leaves for a matching level that carries an identifier and returns absent otherwise with identifier query yielding negative one on miss, architecture info selection is a boolean build choice, and aliasing queries report false for data with instruction following data.
Level based cache descriptor lookup requires callers to hold CPUs online protection as verified by assertion.
One shot control pairs a phase indicator with a mutex, initialized to not started with dynamic lock class setup, and a helper macro supplies static lock class storage at the call site.
One shot phases are numbered zero for not started, one for running, and two for completed.

One shot execution completes immediately when already completed, otherwise serializes callers, treats running state as misuse signalling an invalid argument error, runs the callback exactly once on first entry, returns the control to idle on negative callback status and advances to completed on success.

One shot control uses a fast acquire check to avoid locking after completion and otherwise guards state inspection and callback invocation with mutex scope while pairing acquire and release ordering on the phase indicator.

Confidential computing attributes enumerate general memory encryption, host memory encryption, guest memory encryption, guest state encryption, string IO unrolling, guest SNP, guest secure TSC, host SNP readiness and secure AVIC readiness as successive values starting from zero.
Platform capability queries report absence and capability updates do nothing in the default build.
A character device descriptor combines object lifetime linkage, owning module reference, file operation dispatch, device list linkage, device numbering and device count with randomized field layout.

Control flow integrity helpers forward addressless failure reports with empty type context, report trap status as false, finalize modules with no action, and suppress sealing decoration by default, with function hash and offset queries having active and inert build variants.

Active function hash retrieval reads a word located four before the function entry through a fault tolerant kernel read, yielding zero on fault, while inert builds return zero offset and zero hash with zero constants for BPF cases.
Typed symbol emission provides a type identifier directive and entry macros that place the identifier before the symbol label with caller supplied linkage and alignment.
DMA minimal alignment presence is declared and defaults to the alignment of the widest unsigned integer.
Each header in this set defines a unique inclusion guard to make repeated inclusion harmless.
